component.name: PDF to Audio
component.summary: Read documents aloud with a local cloned voice

description.p: Convert PDF and text documents to audio on your own computer. Select several documents, choose a voice sample, and create recordings in their original languages. The default 0.6B Qwen models download during installation; optional 1.7B models download when selected. NVIDIA acceleration requires a compatible host driver; CPU mode is available without one.
